messages:
June: dropped a new mock for inline diff comments on regression runs. main idea: allow reviewers to leave a scoped comment on a single diff row and optionally flag the prompt set for re-run. figma: https://figma.redwood/inline-diff-2 :eyes:
Marcus: looks promising. question: when a reviewer flags a prompt set, should that automatically fail the test suite or just tag it for follow-up? different orgs will want different defaults.
Ellie: prefer non-destructive default: add a "Needs attention" flag and let owners triage. only an explicit "Fail suite" action should change pass/fail state.
Priya: a11y note: inline comment buttons need clear focus targets and labels. don't rely on icons alone. e.g., button aria-label="Add comment to diff row: 12". Also ensure comment editor is reachable with keyboard and SR announces "comment editor opened".
Kofi: microcopy nit: change "Flag for re-run" to "Mark for re-run" — more active and clearer intent. and tooltip for the flag explaining downstream effects.
June: UX flow question: after comment submit should we collapse the comment or keep it expanded? collapsing hides context. maybe keep it open and highlight the comment bubble briefly.
Marcus: keep open, but collapse older comments by default after 24h. show "Show older comments" to conserve vertical space.
Ellie: for approval workflows: allow reviewers to assign required reviewers per prompt set. small checkbox: "Require approval from X" in the comment modal. permission check: only owners/admins can require reviewers.
Priya: accessibility: when assigning reviewers, use an autosuggest combobox with aria-activedescendant, and announce selection. Also ensure the user list is keyboard navigable.
Kofi: performance: rendering diffs with inline editors across a 500-item run may be heavy. consider virtualizing rows and lazy-mounting editor components when a comment button is focused or clicked.
June: agree. also propose a bulk-action: "Batch comment" where you can create a templated comment and apply to selected diffs. needs to be obvious in UI and reversible.
Marcus: revert/bulk-unapply should be possible. add an audit trail entry for bulk actions. telemetry: events for comment-create, flag-mark, assign-reviewer, batch-comment.
Ellie: copy suggestion for empty comment placeholder: "Add a note for reviewers — explain why this output is unexpected or how to reproduce." helps with triage.
Priya: acceptance criteria checklist: keyboard-only comment flow, SR announces editor open/close and new comment count, focus management when modal opens, contrast of comment bubble >= 3:1, and test with NVDA/VoiceOver.
June: action items: Marcus prototype virtualization + audit trail, Priya to write a11y tests, Ellie to draft microcopy and reviewer assignment rules, Kofi to spec lazy-mount. I'll update figma and schedule a 20m review Thursday. :white_check_mark:
